It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and conditions as per tender documents.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Tender should have an average annual turnover of Rs. 25 lakhs per years in the car rental, Business during the past 3 financial year and shall provide auditor certificate and IT returns in this regard.

Tenderer should furnish list of govt. department and other customers with the contact address and phone no's, and e-mail address in ANEXURE-2. To whom similar services has been provided in previous years -Should have supplied at least 3 cars to Karnataka state government department in the past 2 years. A letter for having satisfactorily providing service should be provided.

Tenderer should furnish document related to the vehicles make and model of the cars proposed to be allotted to ESISMS along with the copies of RTO registrations, Insurance, Emission test document, Karnataka state taxi permit and driving license with badge extra of the vehicle to be provided for the verification. All these vehicles need to be owned by the tenderer
